items.title: Sandisk (SNDK) Stock Looks Fairly Valued As Its 26x Run Cools
items.summary: Sandisk has had an exceptional run over the past year, yet the current valuation signals are more muted. The Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) estimate points to a share price that is roughly in line with where the stock trades today, while the market multiples still screen it as undervalued. Over the past 12 months, Sandisk has returned more than 26x an initial investment, which means any new buyer now has far less room for error if expectations change.
